verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI exposes a documented Python async API, a CLI, a FastAPI-based Docker server with REST endpoints (e.g. POST /crawl), and an official MCP integration for AI tool connectivity—clearly agentic and machine-usable. However, probes show no discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec or llms.txt, so the REST API lacks a standard machine-readable contract, limiting full 'documented public API' compliance for programmatic discovery.
